name: Snatch and Grab
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Our operatives in the field are reporting heavy Defias activity south of Goldshire. The reports indicate that the Defias have taken over Jerod's Landing and are now using it as a way to smuggle large quantities of contraband from Redridge to Westfall.

I need you to infiltrate the dock house and get me that shipping schedule, adventurer. You will probably find it buried deep in the pockets of the Dockmaster.

...and adventurer, should you be discovered, SI:7 will disavow all knowledge of your existence.
narrative.objectives: Find the Defias Dockmaster and recover the Shipping Schedule for Master Mathias Shaw.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I am astonished... Astonished that Keryn finally found a recruit that could possibly have the makings of a proper Champion. Take this blade, adventurer. A day will come when you will be called upon again to serve the SI:7. Hone your skills, keep your eyes open and that blade sharp.

You won't see us coming but you'll feel it when we get there...
narrative.requestItemsText: Your mortality wanes with every moment you waste loitering in the barracks, Champion.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 10, 1,060 XP in all.
